judge.evidence_requirement: For every semantic score, quote or reference concrete output evidence; a valid file shape alone does not prove a complete guidance outcome.

dimensions.description: Assess whether the outcome gives the agent a complete, scoped procedure from discovery through presentation, including Create/Improve/Review classification, source-backed decisions, branch-specific references, and observable completion. Quote or reference output evidence for every score.

Assess whether the outcome preserves applicable facts, protects unrelated worktree state, stops at authorization boundaries, handles collisions and destructive operations, and distinguishes load edges from read-when pointers. Quote or reference output evidence for every score.

evals.name: complete repository guidance maintenance
evals.prompt: Update the supplied repository's agent guidance for the new deployment workflow. AGENTS.md currently contains the standard test command, a durable prohibition on production data in fixtures, and a long deployment section. docs/deployment.md now owns the deployment procedure, including required rollback evidence; AGENTS.md still names the retired deployment command. CLAUDE.md points to AGENTS.md. The user has approved replacing the duplicated deployment section with a route to its canonical procedure while retaining other rules. All scoped paths are clean, tracked regular files. A separate untracked sketch.md belongs to another task. Produce the revised guidance and a report of the changes and validation.
evals.expected_output: A reviewable repository guidance result with an evidence-led workflow, complete migration and mutation accounting, safe authorization boundaries, resolved pointer/load relationships, and verification in effective load order.
expectations: The treatment produces an executable project-guidance outcome rather than a generic README or a copied template.
The outcome classifies Create, Improve, or Review from actual applicable instructions and preserves source-backed ownership, compatibility, workflow, safety, and environment facts.
Every retained, moved, or deleted section has a ledger disposition and every write has an in-scope mutation manifest entry.
The outcome checks target collisions, symlinks, Git state, and destructive or scope-expanding operations before writing, while preserving unrelated changes.
References are routed with explicit read-when triggers and are not described as automatic imports unless the host guarantees that behavior.
The final result reports effective-load-order verification, tested host/model boundaries, and untested gaps without overstating product or model correctness.
The matched No-Skill control receives the same task without the package.
